description:
Know where you stand before you raise. Start with your website address and answer a few short questions. You see which of the four ways to fund a plan fit your business, debt, equity, grants or your own cash, down to the products and the providers in range. The first answer is on screen in under a minute, with no account needed.

Connect your re:cap account and the same conversation runs on your own numbers. Cash, runway, margin, growth and customer concentration, kept current from your bank and accounting data. Your reporting tells you what happened. Here you get what it did to your options: which stay open, which close, and when.

defaultPrompt: Should we get equity, debt, or hold off?
We want to buy a competitor. Do our numbers support it?
How much runway do we have?
